title: The marketplace flywheel is already turning: each quarter of seller growth compounds into **19%** [[src:recon]] cheaper fulfilment
subtitle: Why scale advantages here are structural, not promotional
notes: Say: start at the top of the wheel and walk it clockwise once. Point at the highlighted stage — unit costs — because that is where the loop becomes a moat. Expect the question: what breaks the loop?

stats.label: seller base vs two years ago [[src:recon]]

items.text: Repeat-buyer share climbed from **31%** [[src:est]] to **47%** [[src:est]] as selection widened.
Every 10-point rise in seller count cut delivery distance **8%** [[src:est]] — density is the mechanism.
Competitors subsidise demand; the loop makes ours self-funding.
